findingDetails.title: Misspelled --check silently bypasses the screenshot-coverage gate and falls into the write path
findingDetails.observed: exit=0; stdout 'rendered 0, failed 0' + 'RESULT: PASSED'; no error for --chek; with the legitimate --check the same renderer prints 'MISSING page.html' + 'RESULT: FAILED' and exits 1, so the typo silently skipped the coverage gate and entered the capture path
findingDetails.claim: render-screenshots.cjs extracts positionals with args.filter((a) => !a.startsWith('--')) and modes with args.includes, so an unknown or misspelled flag is silently discarded; with '--check' mistyped as '--chek', check mode never activates, the run falls into the capture path, prints RESULT: PASSED and exits 0, and the coverage gate silently does not run.
evidenceRefs: repro: --check -> exit=1 MISSING page.html RESULT: FAILED; --chek -> exit=0 RESULT: PASSED; --check --bogus-xyz -> exit=0 without an unknown-option diagnostic
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Read the whole CLI region for an unknown-flag rejection path (none exists). Checked callers with rg across .skilled/commands, .skilled/hooks and the sk-design packet: no hook or CI invocation invokes the renderer, so the typo needs an operator or agent call site. Verified the flag cannot be consumed as a positional because the filter removes every token starting with '--'.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The filter is deliberate so flag order and future '--' switches do not disturb the two positional roots, and the byte-compared sibling corpus would catch an accidental fixed-height overwrite downstream, loudly. The gate bypass needs one mistyped mode flag at the call site, and the script never reports which modes actually ran.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If no caller (command, workflow, agent doc) invokes this renderer's --check/--full-page modes with user-typed flags, or the downstream byte-compare corpus gate is retired, downgrade to P2.

findingDetails.observed: exit=0; zero bytes on stdout and stderr; the token falls to the os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1]) branch and the not-a-file early exit returns silently

findingDetails.title: Unreadable or missing input is counted as clean, so the hygiene gate exits 0
findingDetails.observed: exit=0; stderr 'WARNING: cannot read ... [Errno 2] No such file or directory'; check_file returns 0 for the unreadable path and main's '0 in codes' branch exits 0; with one clean plus one violating file the same script correctly exits 1

findingDetails.title: Unknown flags silently ignored by a file-writing minifier (only --force is read)
findingDetails.repro: none executed (all run modes write minified files into the webflow package, outside $TMPDIR); read-only parser proof
findingDetails.observed: lines 36-37 read args only via args.includes('--force'); the header (lines 6-9) documents only --force; any other token, including a misspelled --force, is discarded and the run proceeds in incremental mode with no diagnostic

findingDetails.title: Extra CLI arguments silently ignored by the two review-gate checkers
findingDetails.observed: both exit=0 with 'OK: ...' lines; argv[2] is the only argument read (check-review-findings.js:87), so everything after the first path is discarded without a diagnostic

findingDetails.title: Unknown flags and a valueless --root silently verify process.cwd() instead of the intended tree
findingDetails.observed: both exit=0 with the full OK report against the repo root; parseRoot falls back to process.cwd() when --root is absent, valueless or misspelled, with no diagnostic naming the verified tree

findingDetails.title: Unknown flags ignored by the corpus and router gates (a misspelled scope flag silently narrows coverage)
findingDetails.observed: check-corpus: full internal run, 'RESULT: PASSED', exit=0, no mention of the flag; verify-router-sync: '5/5 checks passed', exit=0, no mention of the flag; both read options with includes/indexOf only, so a misspelled --extra/--render/--checks is discarded and the run still reports success
